quote.text: Progress is impossible without change, and those who cannot change their minds cannot change anything.

slides.summary: The global greater one-horned rhino population has reached 4,075, with Kaziranga National Park in Assam now sheltering more than 2,600 of them after rhino killings there fell 86% since 2016.
slides.headline: Greater one-horned rhino population reaches 4,075
slides.proves: Coordinated anti-poaching investment, drones and forest camps included, can bring a once-declining megafauna population back to record highs.

picture.query: The global greater one-horned rhino population has reached

slides.summary: After tens of thousands protested her eviction, 87-year-old Maricarmen Abascal will return to her Madrid apartment under a new lease at roughly 500 euros a month.
slides.headline: 87-year-old returns to Madrid apartment after protests
slides.proves: A sustained public protest in Madrid can reverse a completed eviction and restore a tenant's home on comparable terms.

picture.query: After tens of thousands protested her eviction

slides.summary: Brazil's unemployment rate fell to 5.3% for the quarter ending in August, the lowest for that period since records began in 2012, with 103.5 million people employed.
slides.headline: Brazil unemployment falls to 5.3% in August quarter
slides.proves: Brazil's 774,000 new jobs in three months shows a large economy can add formal employment at a record pace.

slides.summary: A SpaceX Dragon capsule carrying four astronauts docked with the ISS in 7 hours 55 minutes, the fastest crewed arrival in the station's history.
slides.headline: Dragon capsule docks with ISS in record 7 hours 55 minutes
slides.proves: A crew and capsule combination demonstrates astronauts can now reach the ISS in under eight hours instead of the usual day or more.

slides.summary: Several bystanders in Wohlen, Switzerland pulled all four young occupants from a burning Fiat Punto after it crashed into a tree, some of the rescuers suffering burns themselves.
slides.headline: Bystanders rescue four from burning car in Switzerland
slides.proves: Ordinary bystanders without equipment or training can save four lives from a burning car before emergency crews arrive.
